item.title: What time Canada’s men’s Olympic hockey quarter-final will be on TV
item.description: Canada is gearing up for the quarter-final of the men's Olympic hockey tournament, and we now know when the game will air on TV.

item.title: There's only one beer brand for sale at Italy's Olympics and it's not what you think
item.description: Italy might be known for their diverse cuisine, but that isn't translating to the beer selection at the Milano Cortina 2026 Olympics.

item.title: Megan Oldham soars to Canada's second gold medal of Milano Cortina Olympics
item.description: Megan Oldham has secured Canada's second gold medal of the Milano Cortina Olympics, soaring the women's freeski big air final.

item.title: Fifteen Fifteen: 'Jenga' tower under construction in downtown Vancouver begins to take shape
item.description: Vancouver's Fifteen Fifteen tower, often compared to a game of Jenga because of its protruding design, is beginning to take shape.

item.title: Marie-Philip Poulin makes history as Canada books Olympic gold medal rematch against USA
item.description: Was there ever any doubt? The Canadian women's Olympic hockey team will face-off against the USA in the gold medal game.

item.title: France kicks out Olympic hockey player who fought Canada's Tom Wilson
item.description: France's Olympic hockey team has kicked one of their players out of the tournament after fighting with Canada's Tom Wilson over the weekend.

item.title: Tessa Virtue and Scott Moir reunite at Winter Olympics in Italy
item.description: It turns out Canada's favourite Olympic duo was able to link up at the Winter Olympics again one more time after all.

item.title: Sidney Crosby gave French Olympic goaltender a classy birthday gift
item.description: Sidney Crosby just keeps adding to his Olympic legend, even if it's in ways that might not get nearly as much attention as his Golden Goal.

item.title: Opinion: Why Vancouver's hotel shortage is driving our housing crisis
item.description: Vancouver's hotel shortage and the resulting demand for short-term rentals is driving our housing crisis, especially in downtown areas.

item.title: One last crossing: Thousands take a once-in-a-lifetime walk on the old Pattullo Bridge in farewell before demolition
item.description: Thousands of people took a once-in-a-lifetime walk on the old Pattullo Bridge over the 2026 Family Day long weekend, before its full closure.
